claude_proposed_widenings.name: DamageTypeRef.current_land_choice_resistance
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The class-feature family and passive grants already fit, but the resistance payload cannot honestly express a damage type projected from another active class-feature choice. The current surface only supports fixed damage types or explicit cast/build-time choices, not a runtime-derived lookup keyed by the druid's current land choice.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you have Resistance to a damage type associated with your current land choice in the Circle Spells feature"
